stations.title: Wilma
stations.say: Get your copy from the server.

stations.title: Shop's server
stations.text: The site's history lives here now.

captions: Femi put the shop's repository on a server, and Wilma wants your laptop to have a copy.
The history lives on the server now, and your laptop has nothing to work in.
You clone the server, get Wilma's branch and commit a fix, in three tasks.
Your copy has the whole history and the fix, which waits for Wilma to read it.
One history on a server, and a copy on each computer.
